text_unit.slicing: 原文 offset 取子串；词边界对齐；不用 decode 文本当原文
text_unit.parent_doc_fallback: 不足一窗的文档整篇为 1 片

bm25.note: bm25s 默认 k1=1.5，必须显式传 k1=1.2；不同库默认值不得混称同一种 BM25

dense.query_instruction: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:
dense.parent_score_rule: 父文档分数 = 该父文档所有片段中的最高分；必须分块扫描全部向量取 max，不得只取片段 top-k

hybrid.weight: 等权（BM25 与 Dense 各 1）

historical_input_budget: Phase2 initially 4096 BGE tokens; Phase3 16000 UTF-8 bytes including headers/separators; sensitivity32000 bytes. Not verified generator tokens.
route_deviation: Original measurement freeze fixed host via shared dependency but not exact path/port. This supplements route after semantic release, before first HTTP; no backdated pre-semantic claim. Original semantic protocol, selection and outputs preserved.
model_version_boundary: Requested alias deepseek-flash; role register reported DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash; immutable provider weights not independently verified.
